characters.name: Elara Myung
characters.summary: A senior Aegis technician whose steadiness is famous on Argonaut Station, and whose private fear is that the system is drifting in ways the dashboards refuse to name.

characters.name: Sloane Kestrel
characters.summary: The OSA Compliance Liaison assigned to Argonaut Station: polite, immaculate, and terrifyingly calm, as if the station is a spreadsheet that occasionally develops feelings.

characters.name: Tamsin Velle
characters.summary: A hydroponics shift lead and unofficial station listener who trades in small comforts and small truths, collecting what people won’t write down because it sounds like fear.
